title: Listeners per plan
statementMd:
Count listeners per plan.

Expected columns: `plan`, `listeners`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS listeners FROM listeners GROUP BY plan;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
